correctness_concerns: listProducts omits offset=0 due to truthy check (if (opts.offset)); use opts.offset != null to include explicit 0
PortfolioDashboard correctly separates loading/error/ok-with-empty/ok-with-items; no conflation observed
rls_proxy_concerns: Tenant-isolation test does not attempt body.org_id override (only tests body.orgId); a handler that trusts body.org_id could bypass isolation
GET without orgId test does not assert items.length === 0; loop over empty array vacuously passes and would not catch accidental cross-tenant leaks
No test for query/body orgId shadowing (e.g., both header and body provided) beyond orgId; add coverage for precedence and stripping server-side
backfill_idempotence_concerns: normalizeUrl only trims and strips trailing slash; it does not lower-case host/scheme, so casing differences (https://X.com vs https://x.com) can produce duplicates across runs
No normalization for www subdomain or http→https canonicalization; inconsistent upstream data could bypass dedup
Name-based dedup is case-insensitive but not whitespace/punctuation normalized (e.g., 'Press AI' vs 'PressAI'); may allow near-duplicates (not strictly idempotence but may surprise operators)
regression_risks: ESLint no-restricted-syntax rule flags any ArrayExpression named PRODUCTS, which may be used for non-product UI data in unrelated pages/components
If any untouched surface still contains a PRODUCTS array and is not on the allowlist, CI will start failing unexpectedly
eslint_scope_concerns: Import restriction regex /.*lib\/veuProducts$/ misses imports with extensions (e.g., '@/lib/veuProducts.js' or '.mjs'); easy bypass
'PRODUCTS' identifier match is overly broad and may cause false positives for legitimate arrays not representing product registries
Allowlist covers 11 files while ADR mentions 13 legacy surfaces; if any of the remaining legacy files still hardcode products, the rule will fire unexpectedly
migration_safety_concerns: Unique index on (org_id, lower(name)) may fail migration if existing duplicate names (case-insensitive) are present; no remediation step or concurrent build provided
Partial unique index excludes only url='' (empty string); if any legacy rows contain NULL url, uniqueness would apply to NULLs (likely fine given schema default, but worth confirming)
BEFORE UPDATE trigger set_updated_at() is safe and non-recursive; no concern there
must_fix_before_commit: 1. Strengthen ESLint import restriction: update regex to also match optional extensions (e.g., /.*lib\/veuProducts(\.(js|mjs|ts|tsx))?$/) to prevent trivial bypass via file extension.
2. Expand tenant-isolation tests to cover body.org_id injection and verify the handler strips/ignores any org_id/orgId from the body, enforcing org from auth context exclusively.
3. Make backfill URL normalization case-insensitive at least for scheme+host (or entire URL) when building dedup keys and posting, so re-runs cannot create duplicates due to URL casing differences.
nice_to_have_tweaks: 1. In listProducts, include offset when offset === 0 by checking opts.offset != null.
2. Add a test asserting that GET without orgId returns an empty items[] (length === 0) to tighten defense-in-depth coverage.
3. Consider normalizing www. prefix and http→https in backfill dedup (or document decision) to reduce near-duplicate risk.
4. Narrow the no-restricted-syntax VariableDeclarator pattern to target VEU_PRODUCTS/HARDCODED_PRODUCTS only, or add a comment-based opt-out to reduce false positives for legitimate PRODUCTS arrays.
5. Consider building the (org_id, lower(name)) unique index CONCURRENTLY or pre-clean duplicates to reduce migration risk on live data.
